description: Groups, hosts and inventory-level vars (ansible-inventory --graph/--list/--host), always redacted: vault values, secret-like names and secret-shaped values are hidden, templates are shown unrendered. Script and plugin inventory sources run code, so they are skipped unless ANSIBLE_MCP_ALLOW_DYNAMIC_INVENTORY=1 (which can also call cloud APIs); vault secrets are never supplied, so whole-file vaults degrade to a per-file view.

dir.description: Ansible project directory. Default: ANSIBLE_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

group.description: Root the graph at this group

inventory.description: Inventory source relative to dir (default: ansible.cfg's)

vars.description: none | names | values (default: names for the list, values for host)

name: ansible_inventory
title: Inventory structure and vars
